messages:
Arielle Park: Hey all, joining next Tuesday as CS lead. Can someone help with setup: CRM seat, Dialpad, Gong, access to CS playbooks + onboarding collateral, and the customer staging org?
Devon Shaw: Welcome Arielle! Send your work email and Ill request the CRM role and staging org. What region are you covering?
Arielle Park: arielle.park@redwood.ai. West coast SMB. Edit rights on playbook please.
Maya Ortiz: Ill take care of Gong and Dialpad. Dialpad tip: set up a demo greeting and link voicemail to email.
Arielle Park: Thanks Maya. Also need access to the Win/Loss battlecards and the latest pitch deck.
Devon Shaw: Adding you to the "CS-Collateral" folder and the CRM view for "West SMB". No admin rights.
Provisioning Bot: Ticket PRV-2360 created for CRM, Dialpad, Gong, collateral access. ETA 8 hours.
Maya Ortiz: Gong invite sent. Ill share the "CS Onboard - 3 Call Playlists" recording that helped me as a new hire.
Arielle Park: Got the Gong invite. Seeing collateral, but no edit option on the playbook.
Devon Shaw: Fixed. You should have edit rights now. Also added you to #cs-ramp and scheduled a buddy shadow for Wed 10am.
Arielle Park: Awesome. One more: where do I find customer test accounts for demos?
Devon Shaw: Demo accounts in 1Password under Sales/Demos and the staging org assigned to you in CRM.
Provisioning Bot: PRV-2360 resolved: CRM + Dialpad + Gong provisioned, collateral permissions updated. Ticket closed.
Arielle Park: Perfect, appreciate the fast turnaround! Will post any follow-ups here.
